Every measure of the comparison for each variant, relative to the naive on the
same points, in the primary and secondary views; population by population
(AvgRelMAE of the `mae:` and `rmse:` measures) as macros.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-ev-variants-measures
#| tbl-cap: "Every measure of the comparison for the variants, relative to the naive (whole sample; below 1 beats it), and the number of measures worse than the naive: primary and secondary views."
VVALS = va.variant_values(VRES, truth, keys, D, M, pops, years, GROUPS, old_age=OLD_AGE, levels=LEVELS,
                          pi_levels=F["pi_levels"], calibration=CAL, min_points=MIN_PTS, families=FAMILY)
CODES = [c for f in MAIN["full"] for c in MAIN["families"][f]]
vm_rows, rel_rows = [], []
for view in ("primary", "secondary"):
    base_v, var_v = view_values(VALS, view), view_values(VVALS, view)
    r_ = va.ratios_to_naive(base_v, var_v, families=MAIN["families"], composite=MAIN["full"], naive=ev.NAIVE)
    vm_rows.append(r_.assign(view=view, worse=(r_[CODES] > 1).sum(axis=1)))
    for lab in var_v["method"].unique():
        v_ = var_v[var_v["method"] == lab]
        both_, _ = ev.complete(pd.concat([v_, base_v[(base_v["method"] == ev.NAIVE) & base_v["point"].isin(v_["point"])]],
                                         ignore_index=True))
        rel_rows.append(ev.relative_errors(both_, [lab], ev.NAIVE, [c for c in CODES if c.split(":")[0] in ("mae", "rmse")])
                        .assign(view=view))
VM = pd.concat(vm_rows, ignore_index=True)
VREL = pd.concat(rel_rows, ignore_index=True)
VM_OUT = VM[["view", "method", "points", *CODES, "worse"]].rename(
    columns={"method": "Variant", "points": "Points", "worse": "Worse", **TAB_CODE_LABEL})
VM_OUT["view"] = VM_OUT["view"].map(view_name)
save_table(VM_OUT, "tbl-ev-variants-measures",
           "Every measure of the overall comparison for the variants outside it, relative to the naive on "
           "the same points (whole sample; below 1 beats the naive), primary view (late era, 1--15 years) and "
           "secondary view (early era, 1--15 years); intervals by the comparison's one rule.  Worse: the "
           f"number of the {len(CODES)} measures on which the variant is worse than the naive.  " + TAB_CODE_KEY,
           short_caption="The variants relative to the naive", groups="view", spanners=": ", colsep=4,
           wrap={"Variant": "3.8cm"}, long=True,
           formats=formats(VM_OUT, 2, ints=["Points", "Worse"]),
           rank=[latex.Rank([c for c in VM_OUT.columns if c not in ("view", "Variant", "Points")], "min")],
           rank_note="among the variants in each column of each view")
for r_ in VM.itertuples():
    latex.report(f"evVarWorse{VTAG[r_.method]}{r_.view.capitalize()}", int(r_.worse),
                 desc=f"{r_.method}: measures (of {len(CODES)}) worse than the naive, {r_.view} view")
for r_ in VREL.itertuples():
    latex.report(f"evVarAvgRel{CODE_TAG[r_.code]}{VTAG[r_.method]}{r_.view.capitalize()}", r_.avg_rel_mae, digits=2,
                 desc=f"{r_.method}: geometric mean over populations of its error / the naive's, {r_.code}, {r_.view} view")
VW = VM[VM["view"] == "primary"].set_index("method")["worse"]
VW_TEXT = "; ".join(f"{m}, {int(k)}" for m, k in VW.items() if k > 0)
VW_NONE = [m for m, k in VW.items() if k == 0]
VM_OUT.round(2)
```

In the primary view the variants worse than the naive on some of the
`{python} len(CODES)` measures are (with the count): `{python} VW_TEXT or "none"`.
`{python} ("On none: " + ", ".join(VW_NONE) + ".") if VW_NONE else "Every variant is worse on at least one."`

The comparison's intervals are calibrated on the other origins of the era,
later ones included, so they use errors that had not been observed by the
origin.  Intervals from past errors only use, at origin o and horizon h, only
the errors at earlier origins o′ whose outcome had been observed by the origin
(o′ + h ≤ o), where at least
`{python} int(P.section("flowfield")["interval_min_points"])` such errors exist.
The two rules are compared on the points where both give an interval; the early
era has few, because its first origins have no earlier errors.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-ev-past-intervals
#| tbl-cap: "Intervals from past errors only against within-era intervals: coverage of the 80 % and 95 % intervals and the weighted interval score of e₀ (average of the sexes), horizons 1–15, development origins, on the points where both rules give an interval."
PAST = "past errors"    # the rule's label in the table and the macros' descriptions (RT_Q: the sensitivities)
IC = va.interval_comparison({"within era": Q_RULE, PAST: RT_Q}, keys, truth, D, F["pi_levels"],
                            {"1–15": (1, 15)})
ic = IC[(IC["sex"] == "both") & (IC["span"] == "1–15")]
IC_OUT = ic.pivot_table(index="entry", columns=["era", "rule"], values=["in80", "in95", "wis", "n"], sort=False)
IC_OUT = IC_OUT.reindex(index=ENTRIES + [ev.NAIVE])
IC_OUT = IC_OUT[[(st, e, r) for e in D.eras for r in ("within era", PAST) for st in ("in80", "in95", "wis")]
                + [("n", e, PAST) for e in D.eras]]
for st in ("in80", "in95"):
    IC_OUT[[c for c in IC_OUT.columns if c[0] == st]] *= 100
RULE_HEAD = {"within era": "Within the era", PAST: "Past errors only"}
STAT_HEAD = {"in80": "80 %", "in95": "95 %", "wis": "WIS", "n": "Points"}
IC_OUT = pd.concat(
    [pd.DataFrame({f"{RULE_HEAD[r]}: {STAT_HEAD[st]}": IC_OUT[(st, e, r)] for (st, e_, r) in IC_OUT.columns
                   if e_ == e}).rename_axis("Entry").reset_index().assign(Era=ERA_NAME[e])
     for e in D.eras], ignore_index=True)
IC_OUT = IC_OUT[["Era", *[c for c in IC_OUT.columns if c != "Era"]]]
save_table(IC_OUT, "tbl-ev-past-intervals",
           "Intervals from past errors only: each entry's empirical quantiles from its errors at the earlier origins whose "
           "outcome had been observed by the origin ($o' + h \\le o$), at least "
           f"{MIN_PTS} errors per cell, against the comparison's within-era rule (the other origins of the era, "
           "later ones included).  Coverage (\\%) of the 80\\,\\% and 95\\,\\% intervals and the mean weighted "
           "interval score (years) of $e_0$, the average of the sexes, horizons 1--15, on the points where both "
           "rules give an interval (points: their number).",
           short_caption="Intervals from past errors only", formats=formats(IC_OUT, 2, ints=[c for c in IC_OUT.columns
                                                                                 if c.endswith("Points")])
           | {c: "{:.0f}" for c in IC_OUT.columns if c.endswith("%")}, groups="Era", spanners=": ",
           rank=[ranked(IC_OUT, {c: (int(c[-4:-2]) if c.endswith(" %") else "min") for c in IC_OUT.columns
                                 if c.endswith((" %", "WIS"))})],
           rank_note="among the twelve entries in each column of each era, the best being the coverage closest to "
                     "the nominal level and the smallest score (the naive is not ranked)")
for r_ in ic.itertuples():
    rule = "Past" if r_.rule == PAST else "We"
    for lev in F["pi_levels"]:
        latex.report(f"ev{rule}Cov{TAG[r_.entry]}{ERA_TAG[r_.era]}{LEVEL_TAG[lev]}", 100 * getattr(r_, f"in{lev}"),
                     digits=0, desc=f"Coverage (%) of the {lev} % interval, {r_.rule} rule, {r_.entry}, {r_.era} era, "
                                    "h 1-15, points where both rules give one")
    latex.report(f"ev{rule}Wis{TAG[r_.entry]}{ERA_TAG[r_.era]}", r_.wis, digits=2,
                 desc=f"Mean WIS of e0 (average), {r_.rule} rule, {r_.entry}, {r_.era} era, h 1-15")
for era in D.eras:
    n_rt = int(ic[(ic["era"] == era) & (ic["rule"] == PAST)]["n"].max())
    latex.report(f"evPastPoints{ERA_TAG[era]}", n_rt,
                 desc=f"Points with an interval from past errors only (largest over the entries), {era} era, h 1-15")
RT = ic.pivot_table(index="entry", columns=["era", "rule"], values=["in80", "wis"], sort=False)
for era in D.eras:
    for rule, tag in (("within era", "We"), (PAST, "Past")):
        c80 = 100 * RT[("in80", era, rule)]
        latex.report(f"ev{tag}CovEightyMin{ERA_TAG[era]}", c80.min(), digits=0,
                     desc=f"Lowest coverage (%) of the 80 % interval over the entries and the naive, {rule} rule, {era} era")
        latex.report(f"ev{tag}CovEightyMax{ERA_TAG[era]}", c80.max(), digits=0,
                     desc=f"Highest coverage (%) of the 80 % interval over the entries and the naive, {rule} rule, {era} era")
RT_BEST = {(era, rule): RT.loc[ENTRIES, ("wis", era, rule)].idxmin() for era in D.eras
           for rule in ("within era", PAST)}
RT_WIDER = {era: int((RT[("wis", era, PAST)] > RT[("wis", era, "within era")]).sum()) for era in D.eras}


def best_text(era):
    rt, we = RT_BEST[(era, PAST)], RT_BEST[(era, "within era")]
    if rt == we:
        return f"{ev.entry_phrase(rt)}, under both rules"
    return f"{ev.entry_phrase(rt)} from past errors only and {ev.entry_phrase(we)} within era"


RT_HIGHER = (f"for every one of the {len(RT)} forecasters, the naive included" if RT_WIDER["late"] == len(RT)
             else f"for {RT_WIDER['late']} of the {len(RT)} forecasters, the naive included")
IC_OUT.round(2)
```

Intervals from past errors only draw on every earlier origin, early-era ones
included, so in the late era they cover more: their 80 % intervals cover
`{python} num("evPastCovEightyMinLate")`–`{python} num("evPastCovEightyMaxLate")` % of the outcomes,
against `{python} num("evWeCovEightyMinLate")`–`{python} num("evWeCovEightyMaxLate")` % within era,
and their interval score is higher `{python} RT_HIGHER`.  The lowest interval score
belongs, in the late era, to `{python} best_text("late")`; in the early era, to
`{python} best_text("early")`.

The naive's drift runs from each population's first observed year.  A naive
whose drift uses only the last 50 years is a second yardstick: the counts of
measures on which each entry is worse than either.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-ev-measures-window
#| tbl-cap: "Every measure relative to the naive with its drift over the last 50 years, primary view, and the number of measures worse than each naive."
NW_VALS = va.naive_values(truth, M, observed, pops, years, ctx["jobs"]["full"], keys, D, GROUPS, window=D.window,
                          old_age=OLD_AGE, levels=LEVELS, pi_levels=F["pi_levels"], calibration=CAL,
                          min_points=MIN_PTS, families=FAMILY, label=va.NAIVE_WINDOW)
WORSE = va.worse_than_naive(view_values(VALS, "primary"), view_values(NW_VALS, "primary"), families=MAIN["families"],
                            composite=MAIN["full"], methods=ENTRIES, naive=ev.NAIVE).set_index("method")
if not (WORSE["worse"] == meas.loc[ENTRIES, "worse than naive"]).all():
    raise ValueError("the count against the naive differs from tbl-ev-measures'")
NW_OUT = WORSE.rename(columns={"worse": "worse than naive", "worse_windowed": "worse than windowed naive"})
NW_OUT = NW_OUT[[*CODES, "worse than naive", "worse than windowed naive"]].reset_index().rename(
    columns={"method": "Entry", "worse than naive": "Worse: N", "worse than windowed naive": "Worse: W",
             **TAB_CODE_LABEL})
save_table(NW_OUT, "tbl-ev-measures-window",
           "Every measure of the overall comparison, primary view (late era, 1--15 years), divided by the "
           f"value of a naive whose random walks are fitted to the last {D.window} years only (below 1 beats "
           "it), and the number of measures on which each entry is worse than the naive of the comparison "
           "(drift since the first observed year; as in the table of every measure; N) and than this windowed naive "
           "(W).  " + TAB_CODE_KEY,
           short_caption="Measures against a windowed naive", spanners=": ", colsep=4,
           formats=formats(NW_OUT, 2, ints=["Worse: N", "Worse: W"]), rank=[ranked(NW_OUT)],
           rank_note="among the twelve entries in each column")
for label in ENTRIES:
    latex.report(f"evWorseThanNaiveWindow{TAG[label]}", int(WORSE.loc[label, "worse_windowed"]),
                 desc=f"{label}: measures (of {len(CODES)}) worse than the naive with a {D.window}-year drift, primary view")
NW_DIFF = int((WORSE["worse_windowed"] - WORSE["worse"]).abs().max())
latex.report("evWorseWindowMaxChange", NW_DIFF,
             desc="Largest change, over the entries, of the count of measures worse than the naive when its drift uses the last 50 years")
# The ranking itself with the windowed naive as the yardstick (every measure scaled by it).
_pv = view_values(VALS, "primary")
NW_RANK = {comp: cp.overall(pd.concat([_pv[_pv["method"].isin(ENTRIES)],
                                       view_values(NW_VALS, "primary").pipe(lambda d: d[d["point"].isin(_pv["point"])])],
                                      ignore_index=True),
                            MAIN["families"], MAIN[comp], methods=ENTRIES, naive=va.NAIVE_WINDOW,
                            draws=int(OV["draws"]), seed=int(OV["seed"]))
           for comp in COMPOSITES}
for comp, r_ in NW_RANK.items():
    word = "Full" if comp == "full" else "Ezero"
    pos = ev.rank_positions(r_["mean_rank"])
    for label in ENTRIES:
        latex.report(f"evFirstNaiveWindow{word}{TAG[label]}", 100 * r_["first"][label], digits=0,
                     desc=f"{label}: share (%) of SMAA draws ranked first, {COMPOSITES[comp]}, primary view, "
                          f"with the naive fitted to the last {D.window} years as the yardstick")
        latex.report(f"evPlaceNaiveWindow{word}{TAG[label]}", int(pos[label]),
                     desc=f"{label}: position by mean SMAA rank, {COMPOSITES[comp]}, primary view, "
                          f"with the windowed naive as the yardstick")
NW_FIRST = {comp: r_["first"].idxmax() for comp, r_ in NW_RANK.items()}
NW_FF = [plain(CODE_LABEL.get(c, c)) for c in CODES if WORSE.loc[ev.FLOW_FIELD, c] > 1]
NW_FF_TEXT = (f"{len(NW_FF)} measure{'' if len(NW_FF) == 1 else 's'}"
              + (f" ({', '.join(NW_FF)})" if NW_FF else ""))
NW_OUT.round(2)
```

With the windowed naive as the yardstick, each entry's count of measures worse
than the naive changes by at most `{python} num("evWorseWindowMaxChange")`.  Ranked with it as the
yardstick, on the full composite `{python} ev.entry_phrase(NW_FIRST["full"])` ranks first in
`{python} num(f"evFirstNaiveWindowFull{TAG[NW_FIRST['full']]}")` % of the draws
(`{python} num(f"evFirstPrimaryFull{TAG[NW_FIRST['full']]}")` % with the comparison's naive).
`{python} ev.entry_phrase(ev.FLOW_FIELD).capitalize()` is worse than the windowed naive on
`{python} NW_FF_TEXT`.

At the ages where small populations record zero deaths, chapter d5 pools
deaths and exposures over blocks of adjacent years formed on the whole series.
A block can therefore span a forecast origin, and a job's jump-off year can
then share data with years after the origin (disclosed, not
changed).  The counts, and the primary view's comparison again without the
populations whose jump-off year is pooled with later years at a late-era origin
(descriptive).

```{python}
#| label: tbl-ev-pooling
#| tbl-cap: "Pooling blocks that span a forecast origin: block–origin overlaps, the populations involved and the jobs whose jump-off year is pooled with years after the origin, by era."
POOL = va.pooling_counts(artifacts.load("lt_pooled")["blocks"], ctx["jobs"]["full"], D)
POOL_OUT = POOL["summary"].rename(columns={
    "era": "Era", "overlaps": "Block–origin\noverlaps", "overlap_populations": "Populations",
    "jobs": "Jobs", "affected_jobs": "Jobs with a\npooled jump-off", "affected_populations": "Their\npopulations"})
POOL_OUT["Era"] = POOL_OUT["Era"].replace({"held": "recent"})
save_table(POOL_OUT, "tbl-ev-pooling",
           "Pooling blocks that span a forecast origin.  At the ages where small populations record zero "
           "deaths, deaths and exposures are pooled over blocks of adjacent years formed on the whole series "
           "when the data are prepared; a block of years $t_a \\ldots t_b$ spans origin $o$ when $t_a \\le o < t_b$.  "
           "Per era: the block--origin overlaps (each sex's block counted), the populations with one, the "
           "jobs, and the jobs whose jump-off year is one of the years of a block that extends past the origin.",
           short_caption="Pooling blocks that span an origin",
           formats=formats(POOL_OUT, 0, ints=[c for c in POOL_OUT.columns if c != "Era"]))
ALL_ = POOL["summary"].set_index("era").loc["all"]
latex.report("evPoolOverlaps", int(ALL_["overlaps"]), desc="Pooling block-origin overlaps at the evaluation's origins")
latex.report("evPoolPopulations", len(POOL["populations"]), desc="Populations with a pooling block that spans an origin")
latex.report("evPoolPastMedian", float(POOL["overlaps"]["past"].median()), digits=0,
             desc="Median years a spanning pooling block runs past the origin")
latex.report("evPoolPastMax", int(POOL["overlaps"]["past"].max()),
             desc="Largest number of years a pooling block runs past the origin")
for era, row in POOL["summary"].set_index("era").iterrows():
    tag = {"early": "Early", "late": "Late", "held": "Held", "all": "All"}[era]
    latex.report(f"evPoolJobs{tag}", int(row["affected_jobs"]), desc=f"Jobs whose jump-off is pooled with later years, {era}")
    latex.report(f"evPoolJobsTotal{tag}", int(row["jobs"]), desc=f"Jobs, {era}")
    latex.report(f"evPoolJobPops{tag}", int(row["affected_populations"]),
                 desc=f"Populations with a job whose jump-off is pooled with later years, {era}")
NOPOOL_POPS = POOL["affected_populations"]["late"]
NOPOOL = va.share_without(view_values(VALS, "primary"), NOPOOL_POPS, families=MAIN["families"],
                          composite=MAIN["full"], methods=ENTRIES, naive=ev.NAIVE, draws=int(OV["draws"]),
                          seed=int(OV["seed"]))
FIRST_NOPOOL = NOPOOL["first"].idxmax()
latex.report("evFirstPrimaryNoPool", 100 * NOPOOL["first"][FIRST_NOPOOL], digits=0,
             desc="Primary view, full output, without the populations with a pooled jump-off at a late origin: the "
                  "first entry's share (%) of first places")
latex.report("evFirstPrimaryNoPoolFf", 100 * NOPOOL["first"]["Flow field"], digits=0,
             desc="Primary view, full output, without those populations: the flow field's share (%) of first places")
latex.report("evNoPoolPopulations", NOPOOL["populations_left_out"], desc="Populations left out of that comparison")
latex.report("evNoPoolPoints", NOPOOL["points_left_out"], desc="Primary-view points left out of that comparison")
SECOND_NOPOOL = NOPOOL["first"].drop(FIRST_NOPOOL).idxmax()
latex.report("evFirstPrimaryNoPoolSecond", 100 * NOPOOL["first"][SECOND_NOPOOL], digits=0,
             desc="Primary view, full output, without those populations: the next-largest share (%) of first places")
NOPOOL_JOBS = POOL["jobs"][POOL["jobs"]["era"] == "late"]
NOJOB = va.share_without(view_values(VALS, "primary"), jobs=NOPOOL_JOBS, families=MAIN["families"],
                         composite=MAIN["full"], methods=ENTRIES, naive=ev.NAIVE, draws=int(OV["draws"]),
                         seed=int(OV["seed"]))
FIRST_NOJOB = NOJOB["first"].idxmax()
latex.report("evFirstPrimaryNoPoolJobs", 100 * NOJOB["first"][FIRST_NOJOB], digits=0,
             desc="Primary view, full output, without the late-era jobs whose jump-off is pooled with later years: "
                  "the first entry's share (%) of first places")
latex.report("evFirstPrimaryNoPoolJobsFf", 100 * NOJOB["first"][ev.FLOW_FIELD], digits=0,
             desc="Primary view, full output, without those jobs: the flow field's share (%) of first places")
latex.report("evNoPoolJobsPoints", NOJOB["points_left_out"], desc="Primary-view points of those jobs")
print(f"Without {', '.join(NOPOOL_POPS)} ({NOPOOL['points_left_out']} points): {ev.entry_phrase(FIRST_NOPOOL)} "
      f"first in {100 * NOPOOL['first'][FIRST_NOPOOL]:.0f} % of the draws; without their {len(NOPOOL_JOBS)} jobs "
      f"({NOJOB['points_left_out']} points): {ev.entry_phrase(FIRST_NOJOB)} {100 * NOJOB['first'][FIRST_NOJOB]:.0f} %")
# The same two checks on the held-out view, whose share the article quotes beside the primary view's.
if HELD:
    HELD_POOL_POPS = POOL["affected_populations"]["held"]
    HELD_POOL_JOBS = POOL["jobs"][POOL["jobs"]["era"] == "held"]
    HELD_NOPOOL = {
        "Pops": va.share_without(view_values(VALS, "held_out"), HELD_POOL_POPS, families=MAIN["families"],
                                 composite=MAIN["full"], methods=ENTRIES, naive=ev.NAIVE, draws=int(OV["draws"]),
                                 seed=int(OV["seed"])),
        "Jobs": va.share_without(view_values(VALS, "held_out"), jobs=HELD_POOL_JOBS, families=MAIN["families"],
                                 composite=MAIN["full"], methods=ENTRIES, naive=ev.NAIVE, draws=int(OV["draws"]),
                                 seed=int(OV["seed"]))}
    HELD_NOPOOL_FIRST = {k: r["first"].idxmax() for k, r in HELD_NOPOOL.items()}
    for k, r in HELD_NOPOOL.items():
        what = ("the populations with a pooled jump-off at a held-out origin" if k == "Pops"
                else "the held-out jobs whose jump-off is pooled with later years")
        latex.report(f"evFirstHeldNoPool{k}", 100 * r["first"][HELD_NOPOOL_FIRST[k]], digits=0,
                     desc=f"Held-out view, full output, without {what}: the first entry's share (%) of first places")
        latex.report(f"evFirstHeldNoPool{k}Ff", 100 * r["first"][ev.FLOW_FIELD], digits=0,
                     desc=f"Held-out view, full output, without {what}: the flow field's share (%) of first places")
        latex.report(f"evHeldNoPool{k}Points", r["points_left_out"], desc=f"Held-out-view points left out, without {what}")
        latex.report(f"evHeldNoPool{k}Populations", r["populations_left_out"],
                     desc=f"Populations with a held-out point left out, without {what}")
    print(f"Held-out view without {len(HELD_POOL_POPS)} populations "
          f"({HELD_NOPOOL['Pops']['points_left_out']} points): {ev.entry_phrase(HELD_NOPOOL_FIRST['Pops'])} first in "
          f"{100 * HELD_NOPOOL['Pops']['first'][HELD_NOPOOL_FIRST['Pops']]:.0f} %; without {len(HELD_POOL_JOBS)} jobs "
          f"({HELD_NOPOOL['Jobs']['points_left_out']} points): {ev.entry_phrase(HELD_NOPOOL_FIRST['Jobs'])} "
          f"{100 * HELD_NOPOOL['Jobs']['first'][HELD_NOPOOL_FIRST['Jobs']]:.0f} %")
POOL_OUT
```

Without the `{python} num("evNoPoolPopulations")` populations
(`{python} num("evNoPoolPoints")` points of the primary view),
`{python} ev.entry_phrase(FIRST_NOPOOL)` ranks first in `{python} num("evFirstPrimaryNoPool")` % of
the draws and `{python} ev.entry_phrase(SECOND_NOPOOL)` in
`{python} num("evFirstPrimaryNoPoolSecond")` %.  Without only their
`{python} num("evPoolJobsLate")` late-era jobs whose jump-off year is pooled with later years
(`{python} num("evNoPoolJobsPoints")` points), `{python} ev.entry_phrase(FIRST_NOJOB)` ranks first
in `{python} num("evFirstPrimaryNoPoolJobs")` %.  On the held-out view, without the
`{python} num("evPoolJobPopsHeld")` populations with a pooled jump-off at a held-out origin
(`{python} num("evHeldNoPoolPopsPoints")` points), `{python} ev.entry_phrase(HELD_NOPOOL_FIRST["Pops"])`
ranks first in `{python} num("evFirstHeldNoPoolPops")` % of the draws; without only their
`{python} num("evPoolJobsHeld")` jobs (`{python} num("evHeldNoPoolJobsPoints")` points),
`{python} ev.entry_phrase(HELD_NOPOOL_FIRST["Jobs"])` in `{python} num("evFirstHeldNoPoolJobs")` %.
These checks remove data along with the leak, so they show how far the comparison rests on
these populations and jobs.  Two more measure it.  The first scores every entry, as forecast,
against the HMD's published tables (the curated tables without pooling) instead of the
comparison's truth: it shows how much the pooled truth itself changes the scores.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-ev-pool-truth
#| tbl-cap: "The pooled truth: each entry's MAE of e₀ (horizons 1–15) against the comparison's truth and against the published tables, on the jobs whose jump-off year is pooled with later years and on every point."
DP = P.section("data")
LT_CUR = artifacts.load("lt_curated")["lt"]
LT_POOL = artifacts.load("lt_pooled")
LABELS_EV = artifacts.load("event_labels")
TRUTH_UN = va.unpooled_truth(LT_CUR, LABELS_EV, artifacts.load("populations"), artifacts.load("tensor"),
                             q_min=float(DP["q_min"]), min_observed_years=int(DP["min_observed_years"]))
POOLED_JOBS = POOL["jobs"][["pop", "origin"]].drop_duplicates().assign(pooled=True)


def e0_both_errors(pts, tr):
    e_ = ev.errors(pts, tr, keys)
    e_ = e_[(e_["measure"] == "e0_both") & e_["h"].between(1, 15)].assign(era=lambda d: d["origin"].map(ERA_OF))
    return e_.merge(POOLED_JOBS, on=["pop", "origin"], how="left").assign(pooled=lambda d: d["pooled"].fillna(False))


ERR_PO, ERR_UN = e0_both_errors(points, truth), e0_both_errors(points, TRUTH_UN)
TRUTH_DIFF = ERR_PO.merge(ERR_UN, on=["entry", "pop", "origin", "year", "h", "measure", "era", "pooled"],
                          suffixes=("_po", "_un"), validate="one_to_one")
TRUTH_DIFF["d_truth"] = TRUTH_DIFF["error_un"] - TRUTH_DIFF["error_po"]      # pooled truth − published truth
PT_ERAS = ["late", "held"] if HELD else ["late"]
pt_rows = []
for label in ENTRIES + [ev.NAIVE]:
    row = {"Entry": label}
    for era in PT_ERAS:
        for sub, mask in (("pooled jump-off", True), ("every point", None)):
            if era == "held" and sub == "every point":
                continue
            d_ = TRUTH_DIFF[(TRUTH_DIFF["entry"] == label) & (TRUTH_DIFF["era"] == era)]
            if mask:
                d_ = d_[d_["pooled"]]
            row[f"{ERA_HEAD[era]}, {sub}: Truth"] = d_["error_po"].abs().mean()
            row[f"{ERA_HEAD[era]}, {sub}: Published"] = d_["error_un"].abs().mean()
    pt_rows.append(row)
PT_OUT = pd.DataFrame(pt_rows)
# Short group heads for the page (a long head widens its two narrow columns past the text width).
PT_TEX = PT_OUT.rename(columns=lambda c: c if c == "Entry" else
                       c.replace(", pooled jump-off:", ", pooled:").replace(", every point:", ", all points:"))
save_table(PT_TEX, "tbl-ev-pool-truth",
           "The pooled truth: each entry's MAE of $e_0$ (the average of the sexes, horizons 1--15) against the "
           "comparison's truth (the pooled tables; Truth) and against the HMD's published tables after the "
           "curation (Published): in the late era on the jobs whose jump-off year is pooled with years after "
           "the origin (pooled) and on every point (all points), and at the recent origins on the jobs with a "
           "pooled jump-off.  The forecasts are those of the comparison.",
           short_caption="The pooled truth", spanners=": ", formats=formats(PT_TEX, 2), colsep=4)
for era in PT_ERAS:
    tag = ERA_TAG[era]
    pj = TRUTH_DIFF[(TRUTH_DIFF["era"] == era) & TRUTH_DIFF["pooled"] & (TRUTH_DIFF["entry"] == ev.NAIVE)]
    latex.report(f"evPoolTruthDiff{tag}", float(pj["d_truth"].abs().mean()), digits=2,
                 desc=f"Mean |e₀ of the pooled truth − e₀ of the published table| (years), {era}, the points of the "
                      "jobs whose jump-off is pooled with later years, horizons 1–15")
    lower = [lab for lab in ENTRIES
             if PT_OUT.set_index("Entry").loc[lab, f"{ERA_HEAD[era]}, pooled jump-off: Truth"]
             < PT_OUT.set_index("Entry").loc[lab, f"{ERA_HEAD[era]}, pooled jump-off: Published"]]
    latex.report(f"evPoolTruthLower{tag}", len(lower),
                 desc=f"Entries (of 12) whose e₀ MAE on the pooled jobs ({era}) is lower against the pooled truth")
    chg = (PT_OUT.set_index("Entry").loc[ENTRIES, f"{ERA_HEAD[era]}, pooled jump-off: Published"]
           - PT_OUT.set_index("Entry").loc[ENTRIES, f"{ERA_HEAD[era]}, pooled jump-off: Truth"])
    latex.report(f"evPoolTruthChangeMin{tag}", float(chg.min()), digits=2,
                 desc=f"Smallest change of an entry's e₀ MAE on the pooled jobs ({era}), published minus pooled truth")
    latex.report(f"evPoolTruthChangeMax{tag}", float(chg.max()), digits=2,
                 desc=f"Largest change of an entry's e₀ MAE on the pooled jobs ({era}), published minus pooled truth")
ALL_CHG = (PT_OUT.set_index("Entry").loc[ENTRIES, f"{ERA_HEAD['late']}, every point: Published"]
           - PT_OUT.set_index("Entry").loc[ENTRIES, f"{ERA_HEAD['late']}, every point: Truth"])
latex.report("evPoolTruthChangeAllLate", float(ALL_CHG.abs().max()), digits=3,
             desc="Largest |change| of an entry's e₀ MAE over every late-era point (1–15), published minus pooled truth")
PT_OUT.round(2)
```

On the jobs whose jump-off year is pooled with later years, the pooled truth differs from the
published tables by `{python} num("evPoolTruthDiffLate")` years of e₀ on average in the late era.
Against the published tables the entries' MAE on these jobs changes by
`{python} num("evPoolTruthChangeMinLate")` to `{python} num("evPoolTruthChangeMaxLate")` years
(`{python} num("evPoolTruthLowerLate")` of the 12 entries do better against the pooled truth),
and over every late-era point by at most `{python} num("evPoolTruthChangeAllLate")`.

The second removes the leak.  At every origin the pooling of chapter d5 is planned again on
the years up to the origin alone (the same valley ages and settings), and every entry whose
inputs are pooled is forecast again from the result: the flow field and anchored MDMx from the
tensor, Hyndman–Ullah and the coherent model from the rates smoothed after the same pooling, for
the populations whose cells change.  Lee–Carter and bayesLife's e₀ read the unpooled rates and keep
their forecasts; the ensemble is rebuilt from its members, and the naive is fitted to the
published series.  Every entry is then scored against the published tables, on e₀ and the point
forecasts alone: the MAE by horizon band and the comparison on e₀ only, with the intervals of
the comparison's one rule from these errors.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-ev-clean-pool
#| tbl-cap: "Pooling planned on the years up to each origin: the late era's MAE of e₀ by band, as in the comparison and with the clean pooling (scored against the published tables), and each entry's share of first places on e₀ only."
CLEAN = va.clean_pooling_runs(ctx, lt_curated=LT_CUR, lt_pooled=LT_POOL["lt"], de=artifacts.load("hmd_raw")["de"],
                              labels=LABELS_EV, valley=LT_POOL["valley_ages"], ages=artifacts.load("tensor")["ages"],
                              data_params=DP, anchor=E["mdmx_anchor"], workers=WORKERS, name="evaluation_cleanpool")
CLEAN_RES = va.clean_pooling_results(ctx, CLEAN, results)
pts_c = ev.long_points(CLEAN_RES)
naive_c = cp.naive_e0(TRUTH_UN, ctx["jobs"]["full"], LEVELS)
pts_c = pd.concat([pts_c, naive_c.assign(entry=ev.NAIVE, h=naive_c["year"] - naive_c["origin"])
                   [["entry", "pop", "sex", "origin", "year", "h", "e0_fc"]]], ignore_index=True)
ERR_C = ev.errors(pts_c, TRUTH_UN, keys)
ERR_C["era"] = ERR_C["origin"].map(ERA_OF)
if len(ERR_C) != len(errs[errs["measure"].isin(ERR_C["measure"].unique())]):
    raise ValueError("the clean-pooling runs do not cover the comparison's points")
Q_C, _ = ev.empirical_quantiles(pts_c, TRUTH_UN, keys, ENTRIES + [ev.NAIVE], calibration=CAL,
                               pi_levels=F["pi_levels"], min_points=MIN_PTS)
VALS_C, n_inc_c = ev.complete(ev.point_values(pts_c, TRUTH_UN, keys, Q_C, {}, LEVELS, FAMILY, D))
RANK_C = rank(view_values(VALS_C, "primary"), "e0")
RANK_M = OVERALL[("primary", "e0")]
bands_c = ev.band_table(ERR_C[ERR_C["measure"] == "e0_both"], D, ["entry", "era"])
bands_m = ev.band_table(errs[errs["measure"] == "e0_both"].assign(era=lambda d: d["origin"].map(ERA_OF)), D,
                        ["entry", "era"])
cp_rows = []
for label in ENTRIES:
    row = {"Entry": label}
    for b in BANDS[:3]:
        bm = bands_m[(bands_m["entry"] == label) & (bands_m["era"] == "late") & (bands_m["band"] == b)]
        bc = bands_c[(bands_c["entry"] == label) & (bands_c["era"] == "late") & (bands_c["band"] == b)]
        row[f"{b}: Comparison"] = float(bm["mae"].iloc[0])
        row[f"{b}: Clean"] = float(bc["mae"].iloc[0])
    row["First on $e_0$ (%): Comparison"] = 100 * RANK_M["first"][label]
    row["First on $e_0$ (%): Clean"] = 100 * RANK_C["first"][label]
    cp_rows.append(row)
CP_OUT = pd.DataFrame(cp_rows)
# Short heads for the page: "As run" is the comparison; the caption says what each is.
CP_TEX = CP_OUT.rename(columns=lambda c: c.replace(": Comparison", ": As run"))
save_table(CP_TEX, "tbl-ev-clean-pool",
           "Pooling planned on the years up to each origin.  Late era (origins 1955--2000): the MAE of $e_0$ (the "
           "average of the sexes) by horizon band as in the comparison (As run) and when the entries whose "
           "inputs are pooled are forecast again from the pooling planned on the years up to the origin and every "
           "entry is scored against the HMD's published tables (Clean); and each entry's share of the SMAA draws "
           "in which it ranks first in the primary view on $e_0$ only, the same two ways.",
           short_caption="Pooling planned on the years up to each origin", spanners=": ", colsep=4,
           formats={**formats(CP_TEX, 2, ints=[]),
                    **{c: (lambda v: latex.fmt_num(v, 0)) for c in CP_TEX.columns if c.startswith("First")}},
           rank=[ranked(CP_TEX, {c: ("max" if c.startswith("First") else "min")
                                 for c in CP_TEX.columns if c != "Entry"})],
           rank_note="in each column, the best being the smallest MAE and the largest share")
mae_cols = [c for c in CP_OUT.columns if c.endswith("Clean") and not c.startswith("First")]
diff_c = np.abs(CP_OUT[mae_cols].to_numpy() - CP_OUT[[c.replace("Clean", "Comparison") for c in mae_cols]].to_numpy())
latex.report("evCleanMaeMaxChange", float(diff_c.max()), digits=2,
             desc="Largest |change| of an entry's late-era e₀ MAE in a band (1–15) with the pooling planned on the "
                  "years up to each origin and the published tables as truth")
latex.report("evCleanPops", len(set().union(*(set(c["affected"]) for c in CLEAN.values()))),
             desc="Populations whose pooled cells change when the pooling is planned on the years up to an origin")
latex.report("evCleanOrigins", sum(1 for c in CLEAN.values() if c["n_cells"]),
             desc="Origins at which some pooled cell changes when the pooling is planned on the years up to it")
latex.report("evCleanPointsLeftOut", n_inc_c, desc="Points left out of the clean-pooling comparison on e₀ (a measure missing)")
pos_c = ev.rank_positions(RANK_C["mean_rank"])
for label in ENTRIES:
    latex.report(f"evCleanFirstEzero{TAG[label]}", 100 * RANK_C["first"][label], digits=0,
                 desc=f"{label}: share (%) of SMAA draws ranked first, primary view, e₀ only, clean pooling")
    latex.report(f"evCleanPlaceEzero{TAG[label]}", int(pos_c[label]),
                 desc=f"{label}: position by mean SMAA rank, primary view, e₀ only, clean pooling")
CLEAN_FIRST = RANK_C["first"].idxmax()
CP_OUT.round(2)
```

With the pooling planned on the years up to each origin
(`{python} num("evCleanPops")` populations change at `{python} num("evCleanOrigins")` origins),
an entry's late-era MAE of e₀ in a band changes by at most `{python} num("evCleanMaeMaxChange")` years,
and on e₀ only `{python} ev.entry_phrase(CLEAN_FIRST)` ranks first in
`{python} num(f"evCleanFirstEzero{TAG[CLEAN_FIRST]}")` % of the draws
(`{python} num(f"evFirstPrimaryEzero{TAG[CLEAN_FIRST]}")` % in the comparison).

### Paired differences of the error

The SMAA ranks the entries over many measures at once.  Beside it, one measure between two
forecasters at a time: the MAE of e₀ (the average of the sexes) of the flow field minus that of
another forecaster, on the late-era points where both are scored, in the first horizon bands.
The late era's origins share their periods, so the interval resamples whole origins (a block
bootstrap); the share of draws below zero describes the resampling and is not a p-value.  The
other forecasters: the ensemble, bayesLife and anchored MDMx (ranked entries), Lee–Carter from
the observed rates of the jump-off year (a sensitivity above) and FR2-all (a variant).

```{python}
#| label: tbl-ev-paired
#| tbl-cap: "Paired differences of the MAE of e₀ (average of the sexes), the flow field minus another forecaster, late era, by horizon band, with a bootstrap over origins."
CK = P.section("checks")
PAIRS = [tuple(p_) for p_ in CK["paired_pairs"]]
PAIR_BANDS = [tuple(b) for b in D.bands[:int(CK["paired_bands"])]]
ERR_COLS = ["entry", "pop", "origin", "year", "h", "error"]
fr2_err = ev.errors(ev.long_points({"FR2-all": VRES["FR2-all"]}), truth, keys)
pair_err = pd.concat([both_err[ERR_COLS], jo_err[ERR_COLS], fr2_err.loc[fr2_err["measure"] == "e0_both", ERR_COLS]],
                     ignore_index=True)
pair_err = pair_err[pair_err["origin"].isin(D.eras["late"])]
PAIRED = ev.paired_differences(pair_err, PAIRS, PAIR_BANDS, draws=int(CK["paired_draws"]),
                               seed=int(CK["paired_seed"]))
PTAG = {**TAG, **VTAG, "Lee–Carter, last 50 years, actual jump-off": "LcWinJo",
        "Lee–Carter, all years, actual jump-off": "LcAllJo"}
for r_ in PAIRED.itertuples():
    what = f"{r_.a} minus {r_.b}, late era, horizons {r_.band}"
    stem = f"evPaired{PTAG[r_.a]}{PTAG[r_.b]}{BAND_TAG[r_.band]}"
    latex.report(f"{stem}Diff", r_.diff, digits=2, desc=f"Paired difference of the MAE of e0 (years), {what}")
    latex.report(f"{stem}Lo", r_.lo, digits=2, desc=f"Its 2.5th percentile over origin-bootstrap draws, {what}")
    latex.report(f"{stem}Hi", r_.hi, digits=2, desc=f"Its 97.5th percentile over origin-bootstrap draws, {what}")
    latex.report(f"{stem}Below", 100 * r_.share_below, digits=0,
                 desc=f"Share (%) of origin-bootstrap draws in which the difference is below zero, {what}")
latex.report("evPairedOrigins", int(PAIRED["n_origins"].max()), desc="Late-era origins resampled by the paired bootstrap")
latex.report("evPairedDraws", int(CK["paired_draws"]), desc="Origin-bootstrap draws of the paired differences")
# One row group per forecaster compared with the flow field, its horizon bands as rows.
PAIRED_OUT = PAIRED.assign(
    Group=lambda d: d["b"].replace({"Lee–Carter, last 50 years, actual jump-off":
                                    "Lee–Carter, last 50 years, observed jump-off"}),
    **{"Years ahead": lambda d: d["band"], "Below 0 (%)": lambda d: 100 * d["share_below"]})
PAIRED_OUT = PAIRED_OUT.rename(columns={"n_points": "Points", "diff": "Difference",
                                        "lo": "Bootstrap: 2.5 %", "hi": "Bootstrap: 97.5 %"})
PAIRED_OUT = PAIRED_OUT[["Group", "Years ahead", "Points", "Difference", "Bootstrap: 2.5 %", "Bootstrap: 97.5 %",
                         "Below 0 (%)"]]
if (PAIRED_OUT["Group"] != PAIRED_OUT["Group"].shift()).sum() != PAIRED_OUT["Group"].nunique():
    raise ValueError("the paired differences are not ordered by forecaster: a row group would repeat")
save_table(PAIRED_OUT, "tbl-ev-paired",
           "Paired differences of the MAE of $e_0$ (the average of the sexes, years): the flow field's MAE minus "
           "the other forecaster's, on the late-era points where both are scored (Points), by horizon band.  "
           f"The bootstrap resamples the {int(PAIRED['n_origins'].max())} late-era origins with replacement "
           f"({int(CK['paired_draws']):,} draws); its 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles, and the share of draws in "
           "which the difference is below zero (Below 0: the flow field more accurate), which describes the "
           "resampling "
           "and is not a p-value.  Lee--Carter from its observed jump-off is one of the sensitivity analyses, "
           "and FR2-all one of the variants outside the comparison.",
           short_caption="Paired differences of the MAE of $e_0$",
           formats=formats(PAIRED_OUT, 2, ints=["Points"]) | {"Below 0 (%)": "{:.0f}"},
           groups="Group", spanners=": ", colsep=4)


def pair_cells(rows):
    """The forecasters and bands of some rows of the paired table, as words."""
    return "; ".join(f"{ev.entry_phrase(b).replace(', actual jump-off', ' from the observed jump-off')} at "
                     f"{', '.join(g['band'])} years" for b, g in rows.groupby("b", sort=False)) or "no forecaster"


PAIRED_BELOW, PAIRED_ABOVE = pair_cells(PAIRED[PAIRED["hi"] < 0]), pair_cells(PAIRED[PAIRED["lo"] > 0])
PAIRED_OUT.round(2)
```

The bootstrap interval lies below zero (the flow field more accurate) against
`{python} PAIRED_BELOW`, and above zero against `{python} PAIRED_ABOVE`.  In the other cells
it includes zero: with `{python} num("evPairedOrigins")` origins resampled, those differences
are not distinguished from the variation between periods.

## Generality

Three properties of a general forecaster, in the companion only, for every
entry but bayesLife and the
ensemble:

1. **More history must not hurt:** the MAE with every year minus the MAE with
   the last 50 years, at horizons up to 15, in each era, must not exceed the
   margin: twice the typical standard error of a regret between forecasters in
   that era and band (the median, over the other entries, of the standard error of the
   difference of MAE between the flow field and that entry, over a bootstrap of population
   families).  For the flow field the comparison is with its windowed
   variant.  The entry already estimates its shape law and its pace beyond
   the frontier point on the last 50 years, so this test varies the window of
   its remaining speed only; the window curve below varies every component.
2. **Stable structure across origins:** the flow field's frontier point,
   its speed there, its pace beyond, the shrinkage weight and the relaxation
   rates by origin (chapter 11, @tbl-fc-flow); MDMx's damping ρ by origin
   (@tbl-ev-rho, after the generality table).
3. **Bounded regret out of era:** each entry's early-era MAE minus the best
   entry's, by band.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-ev-generality
#| tbl-cap: "Generality: whether more history hurts (MAE with every year minus with the last 50 years, horizons 1–15, against margins of twice the typical standard error of a regret) and the early-era regret by band."
dev_both = both_err[both_err["era"].isin(list(D.eras))]
WM = E["window_margins"]
MARGIN_TAB = ev.regret_margins(dev_both, D, ev.FLOW_FIELD, [e for e in ENTRIES if e != ev.FLOW_FIELD], FAMILY,
                               WM["bands"], multiplier=float(WM["multiplier"]), draws=int(WM["draws"]),
                               seed=int(WM["seed"]))
MARGINS = {era: dict(zip(g["band"], g["margin"], strict=True)) for era, g in MARGIN_TAB.groupby("era", sort=False)}
for _, r_ in MARGIN_TAB.iterrows():
    latex.report(f"evMargin{ERA_TAG[r_['era']]}{BAND_TAG[r_['band']]}", r_["margin"], digits=2,
                 desc=f"Margin of the test that more history must not hurt (years), {r_['era']} era, horizons "
                      f"{r_['band']}: {WM['multiplier']} × the median bootstrap SE of a difference of MAE")
latex.report("evMarginDraws", int(WM["draws"]), desc="Bootstrap draws of the margins of the generality test")
gen_pairs = {"MDMx + anchor": ("MDMx + anchor, all years", "MDMx + anchor, last 50 years"),
             "Lee–Carter": ("Lee–Carter, all years", "Lee–Carter, last 50 years"),
             "Hyndman–Ullah": ("Hyndman–Ullah, all years", "Hyndman–Ullah, last 50 years"),
             "Coherent FDM": ("Coherent FDM, all years", "Coherent FDM, last 50 years")}
ffw = ev.long_points({"Flow field, windowed": ff_form("Flow field, windowed")})
ffw_err = ev.errors(ffw, truth, keys)
ffw_err = ffw_err[ffw_err["measure"] == "e0_both"].assign(era=lambda d: d["origin"].map(ERA_OF))
grows = []
for name, (all_, win_) in [*gen_pairs.items(), ("Flow field", ("Flow field", "Flow field, windowed"))]:
    e_all = dev_both[dev_both["entry"] == all_]
    e_win = ffw_err if win_ == "Flow field, windowed" else dev_both[dev_both["entry"] == win_]
    rob = ev.window_robustness(ev.band_table(e_all.assign(entry=name), D, ["entry", "era"]),
                               ev.band_table(e_win.assign(entry=name), D, ["entry", "era"]), MARGINS, ["entry"])
    row = {"Entry": name}
    for era in D.eras:
        r_ = rob[rob["era"] == era]
        row[f"{era}: largest excess"] = float((r_["diff"] - r_["margin"]).max())
        row[f"{era}: hurts"] = "yes" if bool(r_["hurts"].any()) else "no"
    grows.append(row)
early_bands = ev.regret(bands[(bands["era"] == "early") & bands["band"].isin(BANDS[:3])
                              & bands["entry"].isin(ENTRIES)])
reg = early_bands.pivot_table(index="entry", columns="band", values="regret", observed=True)
gen_tab = pd.DataFrame(grows)
for name, (all_, _) in [*gen_pairs.items(), ("Flow field", ("Flow field", None))]:
    for b in BANDS[:3]:
        gen_tab.loc[gen_tab["Entry"] == name, f"early regret {b}"] = reg.loc[all_, b]
GEN_OUT = gen_tab.rename(columns={
    **{f"{era}: largest excess": f"{ERA_HEAD[era]}: Largest\nexcess" for era in D.eras},
    **{f"{era}: hurts": f"{ERA_HEAD[era]}: Hurts" for era in D.eras},
    **{f"early regret {b}": f"Early-era regret: {b}" for b in BANDS[:3]}})
save_table(GEN_OUT, "tbl-ev-generality",
           "Generality of the forecasters (origins 1900--2000).  More history hurts if the MAE of $e_0$ with "
           "every year exceeds the MAE with the last 50 years by more than the margin in some band up to 15 "
           "years: twice the typical standard error of a regret between forecasters in that era and band "
           "(largest excess over the margin shown; negative: within it).  For the flow "
           "field the comparison is with its windowed variant.  Early regret: the entry's early-era MAE "
           "minus the best entry's (all-years fits).",
           short_caption="Generality of the forecasters", formats=formats(GEN_OUT, 2), spanners=": ",
           rank=[ranked(GEN_OUT)], rank_note="in each column, the best being the smallest excess and regret")
HURTS = {r_["Entry"]: [era for era in D.eras if r_[f"{era}: hurts"] == "yes"] for _, r_ in gen_tab.iterrows()}
best_early = reg.loc[:, BANDS[:3]].idxmin().unique()
GEN_TAG = {"MDMx + anchor": "Mdmx", "Lee–Carter": "Lc", "Hyndman–Ullah": "Hu", "Coherent FDM": "Cfdm",
           "Flow field": "Ff"}
for _, row in gen_tab.iterrows():
    for era in D.eras:
        latex.report(f"evHistoryExcess{GEN_TAG[row['Entry']]}{ERA_TAG[era]}", row[f"{era}: largest excess"],
                     digits=2,
                     desc=f"{row['Entry']}: largest excess of MAE(all years) − MAE(last 50) over the margin, {era} era")


def hurt_text(era):
    """The comparators that more history hurts in ``era``, each with its largest excess over the margin."""
    names = {"Lee–Carter": "Lee–Carter", "Hyndman–Ullah": "Hyndman–Ullah", "Coherent FDM": "the coherent model"}
    parts = []
    for e, name in names.items():
        if era in HURTS[e]:
            key = f"evHistoryExcess{GEN_TAG[e]}{ERA_TAG[era]}"
            # An excess that prints as 0.00 is still above the margin: say so rather than print zero.
            by = "less than 0.01 years" if round(val(key), 2) == 0 else f"{num(key)} years"
            parts.append(f"{name} (by {by})")
    if not parts:
        return "none of the comparators"
    return parts[0] if len(parts) == 1 else ", ".join(parts[:-1]) + " and " + parts[-1]


gen_tab.round(2)
```

MDMx's structure by origin is its damping factor ρ (chapter 11, step 3), one
per population and fitting period, fitted only to data up to the origin.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-ev-rho
#| tbl-cap: "MDMx's structure by origin (development origins): the damping factor ρ (quartiles over the populations) and the median drift target of the first score, every year and the last 50 years."
rho = pd.concat([r["jobs"][["pop", "origin", "rho", "target_1"]].assign(policy=pol)
                 for pol in ("full", "win") for o, r in runs["mdmx"][pol].items() if ERA_OF[int(o)] in D.eras])
POL_NAME = {"full": "every year", "win": f"last {D.window} years"}
rho_tab = (rho.groupby(["origin", "policy"])["rho"].describe()[["count", "25%", "50%", "75%"]]
           .join(rho.groupby(["origin", "policy"])["target_1"].median().rename("drift target"))
           .unstack("policy"))
STAT_RHO = {"count": "Popu-\nlations", "25%": "25 %", "50%": "50 %", "75%": "75 %", "drift target": "Drift\ntarget"}
rho_tab.columns = [f"{POL_NAME[pol].capitalize()}: {STAT_RHO[stat]}" for stat, pol in rho_tab.columns]
rho_tab = rho_tab[[c for pol in POL_NAME.values() for c in rho_tab.columns
                   if c.startswith(pol.capitalize())]].reset_index().rename(columns={"origin": "Origin"})
save_table(rho_tab, "tbl-ev-rho",
           "MDMx's structure by origin (origins 1900--2000): the number of populations, the quartiles of the "
           "damping factor $\\rho$ over them, and the median drift target of the first score (per year), with "
           f"every year and with the last {D.window} years.",
           short_caption="MDMx's structure by origin",
           formats=formats(rho_tab, 3, ints=[c for c in rho_tab.columns if c.endswith("lations")])
           | {"Origin": latex.fmt_year}, spanners=": ")
lo_bound = ctx["mdmx"].rho_bounds[0]
q25 = rho[rho["policy"] == "win"].groupby("origin")["rho"].quantile(0.25)
AT_BOUND = sorted(int(o) for o, v in q25.items() if ERA_OF[int(o)] == "late" and v <= lo_bound + 1e-6)
# The article writes these origins as a range, so they must be consecutive late origins.
_late = sorted(int(o) for o in D.eras["late"])
if AT_BOUND and AT_BOUND != _late[_late.index(AT_BOUND[0]):_late.index(AT_BOUND[0]) + len(AT_BOUND)]:
    raise ValueError(f"the late origins with the lower quartile of rho at the bound are not consecutive: {AT_BOUND}")
if not AT_BOUND:
    raise ValueError("no late origin has the lower quartile of rho at the bound; the article's sentence must change")
latex.report("evRhoBoundFirstOrigin", AT_BOUND[0], text=latex.fmt_year(AT_BOUND[0]),
             desc="First late origin at which the lower quartile of MDMx's rho (last 50 years) sits at its bound")
latex.report("evRhoBoundLastOrigin", AT_BOUND[-1], text=latex.fmt_year(AT_BOUND[-1]),
             desc="Last late origin at which the lower quartile of MDMx's rho (last 50 years) sits at its bound")
regret_mdmx = gen_tab.loc[gen_tab["Entry"] == "MDMx + anchor",
                          [c for c in gen_tab.columns if c.startswith("early regret")]].to_numpy().max()
latex.report("evRegretEarlyMaxMdmx", regret_mdmx, digits=2,
             desc="Anchored MDMx: largest early-era regret (MAE minus the best entry's), bands up to 15 years")
latex.report("evRegretEarlyOneFiveFf", float(reg.loc["Flow field", BANDS[0]]), digits=2,
             desc=f"Flow field: early-era regret (MAE minus the best entry's) at {BANDS[0]} years")
rho_era = rho.assign(era=rho["origin"].astype(int).map(ERA_OF))
for era in D.eras:
    for pol, ptag in (("full", "All"), ("win", "Win")):
        latex.report(f"evRhoMedian{ERA_TAG[era]}{ptag}",
                     float(rho_era[(rho_era["era"] == era) & (rho_era["policy"] == pol)]["rho"].median()), digits=2,
                     desc=f"MDMx: median damping factor rho over the {era} origins' fits, "
                          f"{'every year' if pol == 'full' else 'last 50 years'}")
rho_tab.round(3)
```

More history `{python} "does not hurt" if not HURTS["Flow field"] else "hurts"` the flow field
(largest excess of its error with every year over the margins
`{python} num("evHistoryExcessFfEarly")` years in the early era and
`{python} num("evHistoryExcessFfLate")` in the late era; negative is inside) and
`{python} "does not hurt" if not HURTS["MDMx + anchor"] else "hurts"` anchored MDMx
(`{python} num("evHistoryExcessMdmxEarly")` and `{python} num("evHistoryExcessMdmxLate")`).
Beyond the margin, more history hurts in the early era `{python} hurt_text("early")`,
and in the late era `{python} hurt_text("late")`.  Out of era, `{python} " and ".join(ev.entry_phrase(e) for e in best_early)`
`{python} "has" if len(best_early) == 1 else "have"` the smallest early-era error in the
bands up to 15 years; anchored MDMx's regret is at most
`{python} num("evRegretEarlyMaxMdmx")` years.  MDMx's damping factor is stable across origins (median
`{python} num("evRhoMedianLateAll")` with every year and
`{python} num("evRhoMedianLateWin")` with the last 50 years in the late era,
`{python} num("evRhoMedianEarlyAll")` and `{python} num("evRhoMedianEarlyWin")` in
the early era).  With the last 50 years, the lower quartile sits at the bound
of `{python} f"{lo_bound:.2f}"` at `{python} len(AT_BOUND)` of the
`{python} len(D.eras["late"])` late origins
(`{python} ", ".join(str(o) for o in AT_BOUND)`).

### The window curve

Each entry (but bayesLife and the ensemble) fitted to its last 25, 50, 75 and
100 years and to every year (development origins).  The flow
field is windowed by component: its speed only, its shape law only, both, and
both with the space estimated on the window too.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ev-window
#| fig-cap: "The window curve: mean absolute error of e₀ (average of the sexes) by fitting window, horizons 1–15 (top) and 16–50 (bottom), early era (left) and late era (right), development origins, on the common points."
WIN = [int(w) for w in E["window_curve"]]
# The window curve's two spans of horizons: up to the split, and beyond it to the end of the forecast.
SPLIT = int(E["window_curve_split"])
SPAN_SHORT, SPAN_LONG = f"1–{SPLIT}", f"{SPLIT + 1}–{D.horizon}"
report_band(SPLIT + 1, D.horizon, "the window curve's longer horizons")
latex.report("evWindowCurveShortest", min(WIN), desc="Shortest fitting window of the window curve (years)")
cmp_code = {"Lee–Carter": "LC", "Hyndman–Ullah": "HU", "Coherent FDM": "CFDM"}
curve_pts = []
for w in [*WIN, "all"]:
    if w == "all":
        md = runs["mdmx"]["full"]
        cm = runs["comparators"]["full"]
    elif w == D.window:
        md, cm = runs["mdmx"]["win"], runs["comparators"]["win"]
    else:
        md, cm = curve[w]["mdmx"], curve[w]["comparators"]
    curve_pts.append(ev.long_points({"MDMx + anchor": md}).assign(window=str(w)))
    for name, code in cmp_code.items():
        curve_pts.append(ev.long_points({name: {o: fc.comparator_points(r, code, A, ctx["cmp"]["mx_to_qx_ax"])
                                                for o, r in cm.items()}}).assign(window=str(w)))
    for form in ("speed", "shape", "dyn", "dynspace"):
        # At "every year" each curve meets the form with that component on every year: for the speed
        # curve (its shape law stays on the last 50 years) that is the entry itself.
        label = (("Flow field" if form == "speed" else "FF all") if w == "all" else f"FF {form} {w}")
        curve_pts.append(ev.long_points({f"Flow field, {form}": ff_form(label)}).assign(window=str(w)))
curve_pts = pd.concat(curve_pts, ignore_index=True)
dev_keys = keys[keys["era"].isin(list(D.eras))]
wc = curve_pts.merge(dev_keys, on=["pop", "origin", "year"]).merge(truth, on=["pop", "sex", "year"])
wc = wc[wc["sex"] == "both"].assign(err=lambda d: (d["e0_fc"] - d["e0_obs"]).abs())
# Common points: those every entry has at every window (a fit can fail at one window only).
n_var = wc.groupby(["pop", "origin", "year"])[["entry", "window"]].apply(lambda d: len(d.drop_duplicates()))
full_pts = n_var[n_var == n_var.max()].index
cmp_curve_fail = pd.concat([r["failures"].assign(window=w) for w in curve for r in curve[w]["comparators"].values()],
                           ignore_index=True)
print(f"Window curve: comparator fits that failed: {len(cmp_curve_fail)}; development points left out: "
      f"{len(n_var) - len(full_pts)} of {len(n_var)}")
if len(cmp_curve_fail):
    print(cmp_curve_fail.to_string(index=False))
wc = wc.set_index(["pop", "origin", "year"]).loc[full_pts].reset_index()
wc["span"] = np.where(wc["h"] <= SPLIT, SPAN_SHORT, SPAN_LONG)
WINDOW_CURVE = wc.groupby(["entry", "era", "span", "window"])["err"].mean().reset_index()
WCI = WINDOW_CURVE.set_index(["era", "span", "entry", "window"])["err"]
WC_TAG = {"MDMx + anchor": "Mdmx", "Lee–Carter": "Lc", "Hyndman–Ullah": "Hu", "Coherent FDM": "Cfdm",
          "Flow field, speed": "FfSpeed", "Flow field, shape": "FfShape", "Flow field, dyn": "FfDyn",
          "Flow field, dynspace": "FfDynspace"}
W_TAG = {"25": "Twentyfive", "50": "Fifty", "75": "Seventyfive", "100": "Hundred", "all": "All"}
for (era, span, entry, w), v in WCI.items():
    latex.report(f"evWindow{WC_TAG[entry]}{ERA_TAG[era]}{'Short' if span == SPAN_SHORT else 'Long'}{W_TAG[w]}", v,
                 digits=2, desc=f"Window curve: {entry}, {era} era, horizons {span}, window {w}")
order = [str(w) for w in WIN] + ["all"]
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(10, 7), sharex=True)
colors = {"MDMx + anchor": "#1f78b4", "Lee–Carter": plotting.COLORS["LC"], "Hyndman–Ullah": plotting.COLORS["HU"],
          "Coherent FDM": plotting.COLORS["CFDM"], "Flow field, speed": "#b2df8a", "Flow field, shape": "#33a02c",
          "Flow field, dyn": plotting.COLORS["MDMx"], "Flow field, dynspace": "#a6cee3"}
# The legend's names: the flow field's curves by the components fitted to the window.
WC_NAME = {"Flow field, speed": "Flow field: speed", "Flow field, shape": "Flow field: shape law",
           "Flow field, dyn": "Flow field: speed and shape law",
           "Flow field, dynspace": "Flow field: speed, shape law and space"}
for i, span in enumerate((SPAN_SHORT, SPAN_LONG)):
    for j, era in enumerate(D.eras):
        ax = axes[i, j]
        for name, col in colors.items():
            c = WINDOW_CURVE[(WINDOW_CURVE["entry"] == name) & (WINDOW_CURVE["era"] == era)
                             & (WINDOW_CURVE["span"] == span)].set_index("window").reindex(order)
            ax.plot(order, c["err"], marker="o", ms=3, color=col, label=WC_NAME.get(name, shown_name(name)))
        ax.set_title(f"{era.capitalize()} era, horizons {span}")
        if j == 0:
            ax.set_ylabel("MAE of e₀ (years)")
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel("Fitting window (years)")
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel("Fitting window (years)")
axes[0, 1].legend(frameon=False, fontsize=6)
plotting.save_figure(fig, "fig-ev-window");
```

Anchored MDMx barely depends on its window: its late-era error at `{python} SPAN_SHORT` years
ranges from `{python} f"{WCI.loc[('late', SPAN_SHORT, 'MDMx + anchor')].min():.2f}"` to
`{python} f"{WCI.loc[('late', SPAN_SHORT, 'MDMx + anchor')].max():.2f}"` years across the windows.
In the late era Lee–Carter is best with 50 years
(`{python} num("evWindowLcLateShortFifty")`, against `{python} num("evWindowLcLateShortAll")`
with every year and `{python} num("evWindowLcLateShortTwentyfive")` with `{python} min(WIN)`); in the early era
all three comparators are best with the shortest window (Lee–Carter
`{python} num("evWindowLcEarlyShortTwentyfive")` with `{python} min(WIN)` years against
`{python} num("evWindowLcEarlyShortAll")` with every year).  The flow field's
long-horizon error depends on the window of its shape law, in opposite
directions in the two eras: at `{python} SPAN_LONG` years a shape law on the last `{python} min(WIN)` years
gives `{python} num("evWindowFfShapeLateLongTwentyfive")` in the late era against
`{python} num("evWindowFfShapeLateLongAll")` on every year, but
`{python} num("evWindowFfShapeEarlyLongTwentyfive")` in the early era against
`{python} num("evWindowFfShapeEarlyLongAll")`.  The entry's form (the shape law on
the last 50 years) gives `{python} num("evWindowFfShapeLateLongFifty")` and
`{python} num("evWindowFfShapeEarlyLongFifty")`.

What this says about the guiding principle of the forecasters, one general model that uses all
the data (in the companion only).  Its strong
form, that a general model should not need to discard history, does not hold
for the flow field: two of its three components, the shape law and the pace
beyond the frontier point, use only the last 50 years, a window chosen on the
late origins (Deviation 1), and the shape law's window moves the error in
opposite directions in the two eras.  The narrowed form, pre-registered as the
fallback, is that the weight of each datum reflects its
relevance and may approach zero.  The flow field meets it only coarsely: its
window gives the older years a weight of zero, set by a choice rather than
estimated in the model.  Its remaining component, the speed, uses every year,
and there more history `{python} "does not hurt" if not HURTS["Flow field"] else "hurts"` (the generality table).

## Where the errors come from

### By age

Arriaga's decomposition (paper §10.8) splits each e₀ error into the contributions of age
groups, by sex; the contributions add up to the error exactly (checked).  Late
era, the longer horizons, for every entry with schedules.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ev-arriaga
#| fig-cap: "Where the late-era e₀ errors come from, by age: the mean Arriaga contribution of each age group to the error of female (left) and male (right) e₀, horizons 36–50, selected entries."
AGE_GROUPS = ev.age_groups([int(a) for a in E["age_group_starts"]], E["age_group_labels"], A)
late_keys = keys[keys["era"] == "late"].reset_index(drop=True)
split_rows = []
for label in ENTRIES:
    z = cp.aligned_schedules(results[label], late_keys)
    s = ev.age_split(late_keys[["pop", "origin", "year"]], z, M, observed, pops, years, AGE_GROUPS)
    split_rows.append(s.assign(entry=label, band=D.band(s["year"] - s["origin"])))
SPLIT = pd.concat(split_rows, ignore_index=True)
arr_cols = [f"arr_{g}" for g in AGE_GROUPS]
arr_mean = SPLIT[SPLIT["band"].isin(BANDS[3:])].groupby(["entry", "sex", "band"])[arr_cols].mean()
show = [e for e in ("Flow field", "MDMx + anchor, all years", "Lee–Carter, last 50 years", "bayesLife, last 50 years",
                    "Ensemble") if e in ENTRIES]
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 3.8), sharey=True)
xpos = np.arange(len(AGE_GROUPS))
for ax, sex in zip(axes, ("female", "male"), strict=True):
    for k, label in enumerate(show):
        vals_ = arr_mean.loc[(label, sex, "36–50")].to_numpy()
        ax.bar(xpos + (k - (len(show) - 1) / 2) * 0.16, vals_, width=0.16, label=shown_name(label),
               color=FEATURE.get(label, "0.6"))
    ax.axhline(0, color="0.3", lw=0.6)
    ax.set_xticks(xpos, list(AGE_GROUPS))
    ax.set_title(f"{sex.capitalize()} e₀, horizons 36–50")
    ax.set_xlabel("Age group")
axes[0].set_ylabel("Mean contribution to the e₀ error (years)")
axes[1].legend(frameon=False, fontsize=6)
plotting.save_figure(fig, "fig-ev-arriaga")
for label in ("Flow field", "MDMx + anchor, all years"):
    for sex in ("female", "male"):
        old = arr_mean.loc[(label, sex, "36–50"), ["arr_65–79", "arr_80+"]].sum()
        latex.report(f"evArriagaOld{TAG[label]}{sex.capitalize()}", old, digits=2,
                     desc=f"{label}: mean contribution of ages 65+ to the {sex} e0 error, late era, h 36-50")
```

Late in the horizon every forecaster's e₀ is too low, and the shortfall comes
from old age: at 36–50 years, ages 65 and over contribute
`{python} num("evArriagaOldFfFemale")` years to the flow field's female error and
`{python} num("evArriagaOldMdmxAllFemale")` to anchored MDMx's, and
`{python} num("evArriagaOldFfMale")` and `{python} num("evArriagaOldMdmxAllMale")`
to the male errors.  bayesLife's male error is spread over every age, because
its male e₀ drifts down and its schedules follow it.

### The pace of improvement

For the forecasts that start beyond the frontier point at the late origins (paper
§10.8):
the e₀ gain per year that each forecaster implies along the horizon, beside the
gain the same populations realised and the realised pace of the frontier (the
chain-linked top three).  The realised paces use the years after the origins:
they describe what happened and are never an input to a forecast.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ev-pace
#| fig-cap: "The e₀ gain per year along the horizon for the forecasts that start beyond the frontier point (late origins): implied by four forecasters, realised by the same populations, and realised at the frontier. Five-year centred means."
POS = pd.concat([r["positions"].assign(origin=o) for o, r in runs["flowfield"].items()], ignore_index=True)
beyond = POS[(POS["position"] == "beyond") & POS["origin"].isin(D.eras["late"])][["pop", "origin"]]
pace_entries = ["Flow field", "MDMx + anchor, all years", "Lee–Carter, last 50 years", ev.NAIVE]
pb = points[points["entry"].isin(pace_entries) & (points["sex"] == "both")].merge(beyond, on=["pop", "origin"])
fpace_all = ev.forecast_pace(pb[["entry", "pop", "sex", "origin", "year", "e0_fc"]])
fpace = fpace_all.groupby(["entry", "h"])["gain"].mean().reset_index()
# The realised gain at the last band exists only for the origins that reach it; the implied gain there is
# compared on the same origins.
END_ORIGINS = [o for o in D.eras["late"] if o + D.bands[-1][0] <= int(years[-1])]
fpace_end = fpace_all[fpace_all["origin"].isin(END_ORIGINS)].groupby(["entry", "h"])["gain"].mean()
real = ev.realised_pace(truth[truth["sex"] == "both"])
real = real.merge(beyond, on="pop").assign(h=lambda d: d["year"] - d["origin"])
real = real[(real["h"] >= 1) & (real["h"] <= D.horizon)].groupby("h")["gain"].mean()
front = ev.frontier_pace(ctx["e0"], observed, years, int(E["frontier_k"])).set_index("year")["gain"]
front_h = pd.DataFrame([{"h": h, "gain": front.get(o + h, np.nan)} for o in D.eras["late"]
                        for h in range(1, D.horizon + 1)]).groupby("h")["gain"].mean()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
for label in pace_entries:
    c = fpace[fpace["entry"] == label].set_index("h")["gain"].rolling(5, center=True, min_periods=1).mean()
    ax.plot(c.index, c, color=FEATURE.get(label, "0.5"), lw=1.8, ls="--" if label == ev.NAIVE else "-",
            label=shown_name(label))
ax.plot(real.index, real.rolling(5, center=True, min_periods=1).mean(), color="k", lw=1.8,
        label="Realised, the same populations")
ax.plot(front_h.index, front_h.rolling(5, center=True, min_periods=1).mean(), color="k", lw=1.2, ls=":",
        label="Realised frontier (top 3)")
ax.set_xlabel("Years after the origin")
ax.set_ylabel("Gain in e₀ per year (years)")
ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=7)
plotting.save_figure(fig, "fig-ev-pace")
# The implied gain at the start of the horizon: the first horizons that have one (config: pace_start).
PACE_LO, PACE_HI = (int(h) for h in E["pace_start"])
report_band(PACE_LO, PACE_HI, "the start of the horizon for the implied gain in e0")
for label in ("Flow field", "MDMx + anchor, all years"):
    c = fpace[fpace["entry"] == label].set_index("h")["gain"]
    latex.report(f"evPaceStart{TAG[label]}", c.loc[PACE_LO:PACE_HI].mean(), digits=3,
                 desc=f"{label}: mean implied e0 gain per year at horizons {PACE_LO}-{PACE_HI} (jobs beyond s1*, "
                      "late era)")
    lo_, hi_ = D.bands[-1]
    latex.report(f"evPaceEnd{TAG[label]}", fpace_end.loc[label].loc[lo_:hi_].mean(), digits=3,
                 desc=f"{label}: mean implied e0 gain per year in the last band (jobs beyond s1*, late origins "
                      "that reach it)")
latex.report("evPaceRealisedEnd", real.loc[D.bands[-1][0]:D.bands[-1][1]].mean(), digits=3,
             desc="Realised e0 gain per year in the last band, the same populations")
```

The forecasters imply a slowing gain: for the forecasts that start beyond the
frontier point, the flow field's implied gain falls from
`{python} num("evPaceStartFf")` years of e₀ per year at `{python} PACE_LO`–`{python} PACE_HI` years ahead to
`{python} num("evPaceEndFf")` at `{python} BANDS[-1]`, and anchored MDMx's from
`{python} num("evPaceStartMdmxAll")` to `{python} num("evPaceEndMdmxAll")`.  The
same populations realised `{python} num("evPaceRealisedEnd")` years per year at
`{python} BANDS[-1]` years after the origin.  Only the origins up to
`{python} max(END_ORIGINS)` reach so far, so the implied gains at that band are taken
over the same origins, and the realised curve is noisy.  Both forecasters slow
down more than the populations did; the flow field less so.

### By starting position

The flow field's late-era error by where the forecast starts: beyond the
frontier point, near it (below it by at most
`{python} f"{float(E['positions_near']):.0%}"` of the range of s₁), or far below it.

```{python}
#| label: tbl-ev-positions
#| tbl-cap: "The flow field's late-era error of e₀ (average of the sexes) by starting position relative to the frontier point: mean error (bias) and MAE by horizon band."
ffe = both_err[(both_err["entry"] == "Flow field") & (both_err["era"] == "late")].merge(
    POS[["pop", "origin", "position"]], on=["pop", "origin"])
ffe["band"] = pd.Categorical(D.band(ffe["h"]), categories=BANDS, ordered=True)
pos_tab = ffe.groupby(["position", "band"], observed=True)["error"].agg(
    me="mean", mae=lambda x: float(np.mean(np.abs(x))), n="size").reset_index()
pos_wide = pos_tab.pivot_table(index="position", columns="band", values=["me", "mae"], observed=True)
pos_out = pos_wide.copy()
pos_out.columns = [f"{s} {b}" for s, b in pos_out.columns]
POS_TAB = pos_out.reset_index()
for pos_, row in pos_out.iterrows():
    for b in BANDS:
        if np.isfinite(row.get(f"mae {b}", np.nan)):
            latex.report(f"evPos{pos_.capitalize()}Mae{BAND_TAG[b]}", row[f"mae {b}"], digits=2,
                         desc=f"Flow field, late era, start {pos_} the frontier point: MAE, horizons {b}")
            latex.report(f"evPos{pos_.capitalize()}Bias{BAND_TAG[b]}", row[f"me {b}"], digits=2,
                         desc=f"Flow field, late era, start {pos_} the frontier point: mean error, horizons {b}")
POS_NAME = {"beyond": "Beyond the frontier point", "near": "Near it", "far": "Far below it"}
POS_OUT = years_ahead(pd.concat(
    [pos_wide[st].reindex(columns=BANDS).rename_axis("Position").reset_index().assign(Group=name)
     for st, name in (("mae", "MAE of $e_0$"), ("me", "Mean error of $e_0$"))], ignore_index=True)
    [["Group", "Position", *BANDS]])
POS_OUT["Position"] = POS_OUT["Position"].map(lambda v: POS_NAME.get(v, v))
save_table(POS_OUT, "tbl-ev-positions",
           "The flow field's late-era error of $e_0$ (the average of the sexes, years) by starting position: "
           "beyond the frontier point, near it (below by at most a fifth of the range of $s_1$) or far "
           "below.",
           short_caption="Error by starting position", formats=formats(POS_OUT, 2), groups="Group", spanners=": ")
pos_out.round(2)
```

Beyond the frontier point the flow field is nearly unbiased up to 25 years
ahead and its error is smallest (`{python} num("evPosBeyondMaeOneFive")` years at 1–5
years ahead); near the frontier point it is larger
(`{python} num("evPosNearMaeOneFive")`); far below it, it forecasts too little
improvement (`{python} num("evPosFarMaeOneFive")` at 1–5 years and a mean error of
`{python} num("evPosFarBiasSixteenTwentyfive")` at 16–25).

### The frontier's pace and the flow field's speed beyond it

```{python}
#| label: fig-ev-frontier
#| fig-cap: "By origin: the leading populations' e₀ pace over the 50 years before the origin (the same leaders and years whose pace in s₁ the flow field uses beyond the frontier point), the flow field's implied e₀ gain 2–5 years ahead for the forecasts that start beyond the frontier point, the frontier's realised e₀ pace over up to 25 years after the origin (evaluation only; fewer years from 1995 on, where the data end or the COVID-19 years are masked), and the flow field's speed beyond the frontier point in s₁ units (right axis). The shaded origins after 2000 are the held-out block, shown as data only: the text's numbers are taken over the development origins."
FLOWS = pd.DataFrame([{"origin": o, **r["runs"]["Flow field"]["flow"]} for o, r in runs["flowfield"].items()])
# The frontier's realised pace over the years after each origin (config: frontier_after).
AFTER = int(E["frontier_after"])
latex.report("evFrontierAfterYears", AFTER, desc="Years after the origin over which the frontier's realised pace is taken")
fwd = pd.Series({o: front.loc[o + 1:o + AFTER].mean() for o in FLOWS["origin"]})
# The flow field's own implied e₀ gain beyond the frontier point at the start of the horizon, at every origin.
beyond_all = POS[POS["position"] == "beyond"][["pop", "origin"]]
pb_ff = points[(points["entry"] == "Flow field") & (points["sex"] == "both")].merge(beyond_all, on=["pop", "origin"])
ff_gain = ev.forecast_pace(pb_ff[["entry", "pop", "sex", "origin", "year", "e0_fc"]])
ff_gain = ff_gain[ff_gain["h"].between(PACE_LO, PACE_HI)].groupby("origin")["gain"].mean()
fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3.8))
# The held-out origins are drawn as data only: shaded, and left out of every number below.
HELD_SHOWN = sorted(o for o in FLOWS["origin"] if ERA_OF[o] == "held")
if HELD_SHOWN:
    STEP = int(np.diff(D.origins).min())
    ax1.axvspan(HELD_SHOWN[0] - STEP / 2, HELD_SHOWN[-1] + STEP / 2, color="0.9", lw=0, zorder=0)
    ax1.text((HELD_SHOWN[0] + HELD_SHOWN[-1]) / 2, 0.02, "recent\norigins\n(data only)",
             transform=ax1.get_xaxis_transform(), ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=7, color="0.35")
ax1.plot(FLOWS["origin"], FLOWS["V_e"], marker="o", ms=3, color="k", label="Frontier e₀ pace, 50 years before")
ax1.plot(fwd.index, fwd.values, marker="o", ms=3, color="k", ls=":",
         label=f"Frontier e₀ pace, up to {AFTER} years after")
ax1.plot(ff_gain.index, ff_gain.values, marker="^", ms=3, color=plotting.COLORS["MDMx"], ls="--",
         label=f"Flow field's implied e₀ gain, {PACE_LO}–{PACE_HI} years ahead (beyond s₁*)")
ax1.set_ylabel("e₀ per year (years)")
ax2 = ax1.twinx()
ax2.plot(FLOWS["origin"], FLOWS["v1"], marker="s", ms=3, color=plotting.COLORS["MDMx"],
         label="Flow field's speed beyond s₁* (s₁ per year)")
ax2.set_ylabel("s₁ per year")
ax1.set_xlabel("Origin")
lines = ax1.get_lines() + ax2.get_lines()
ax1.legend(lines, [ln.get_label() for ln in lines], frameon=False, fontsize=7, ncol=2, loc="upper center",
           bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.17))
plotting.save_figure(fig, "fig-ev-frontier");
FR = pd.DataFrame({"ve": FLOWS.set_index("origin")["V_e"], "fwd": fwd, "ff": ff_gain})
FR = FR[FR.index.map(ERA_OF).isin(list(D.eras))]                   # development origins only
latex.report("evFrontierPaceMax", float(FR["ve"].max()), digits=2,
             desc="The leaders' e0 pace over the 50 years before the origin: its highest (development origins)")
latex.report("evFrontierPaceMaxOrigin", int(FR["ve"].idxmax()), text=latex.fmt_year(int(FR["ve"].idxmax())),
             desc="The development origin at which the leaders' e0 pace over the 50 years before it was highest")
latex.report("evFrontierPaceLast", float(FR["ve"].iloc[-1]), digits=2,
             desc="The leaders' e0 pace over the 50 years before the last development origin")
latex.report("evFrontierFfGainExcessMax", float((FR["ff"] - FR["fwd"]).max()), digits=2,
             desc=f"Largest excess of the flow field's implied gain ({PACE_LO}-{PACE_HI} years, beyond s1*) over the "
                  f"frontier's realised pace over the next {AFTER} years (development origins)")

latex.report("evFrontierFfGainShortMax", float(-FR_DIFF.min()), digits=2,

                  f"the frontier's realised pace over the next {AFTER} years (development origins)")
latex.report("evFrontierFfGainShortOrigin", int(FR_DIFF.idxmin()), text=latex.fmt_year(int(FR_DIFF.idxmin())),
             desc="The development origin of that largest shortfall")
latex.report("evFrontierFfGainBelowN", int((FR_DIFF < 0).sum()),
```
